# Register For Events

![Register For Events function icon](../../../../assets/function-icons/functions/dialog/events/01-register-for-events.svg)

[DialogUserInterface functions](../../dialoguserinterface/index.md) · [All functions](../../index.md)

Creates a dynamic subscription, or updates the supplied registration without creating another queue. Each stable row associates a typed source with a compatible event from the common catalog. A UserEvent&lt;T&gt;, an EventRegistration&lt;S&gt; and the payload T are different values. Wire the resulting registration to the existing Event Structure and choose its Dynamic event case. Sharing the same registration between consumers shares its queue; create independent registrations for broadcast delivery. None, null and unwired inputs follow the documented FROG adapter contract, not a measured NI compatibility claim.

UserEvent&lt;T&gt;, EventRegistration&lt;S&gt; et donnée T sont distincts. Raccorder l'inscription à la structure Event existante puis choisir un cas Dynamic. Plusieurs consommateurs d'une même inscription partagent sa file ; créer des inscriptions distinctes pour diffuser à chacun. Les cas None, nul et non câblé suivent le contrat explicite FROG, sans prétendre à une compatibilité NI mesurée.

</details>

## Studio authoring profile

Contract status: **partial**. The connector below describes Studio authoring; execution availability is stated separately.

Register local typed event sources using the common event catalogue. An incoming registration is modified in place with invariant signature. FROG: an unwired row preserves its source; a typed null suspends it; None suspends an existing declared event row without changing its signature. Initial None is diagnosed. These distinctions are not measured NI compatibility.
